response.overview: Keith Jarrett, Gary Peacock and Jack DeJohnette bring their Standards Trio to Tokyo's Bunkamura Orchard Hall on March 30, 1996. Directed by Kaname Kawachi, the film captures the complete concert, spanning jazz standards and improvisations from “It Could Happen to You” and “Autumn Leaves” to “All the Things You Are” and “Tonk.”
response.tagline: One night in Tokyo. Three masters in perfect conversation.
response.title: Keith Jarrett Trio Concert 1996
